name: vitest-4-reads-no-workspace-file
description: Vitest 4 reads no workspace file, so where the installed Vitest is 4 or later vitest.workspace.ts is no entry and the setup files only it names are not test files, while the setup files of each inline project of the configuration's test.projects are, so a helper only such a setup file calls is used only by tests, which is production code only tests use and so carries the class possible. The fixture assumes the analyzer carries a row named vitest for the package vitest from 4.0.0 that does not root vitest.workspace.ts and reads setupFiles from the configuration's test object and from each inline project of test.projects.
